app.name: NativeProbe
app.tagline: Explore what your device can actually do.

device.title: Device
device.description: Platform, OS version, model, and manufacturer for the current device.
device.info: Shows the main device information exposed by the system, such as platform, OS version, model, and manufacturer. Useful for quickly identifying the real environment in which the app is running.

display.title: Display
display.description: Screen dimensions, pixel ratio, orientation, and safe area.
display.info: Shows information about the current display, including dimensions, pixel density, orientation, and other available screen characteristics. Useful for understanding how an app sees the physical screen.

battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Battery level, charging state, and low-power mode.
battery.info: Lets you inspect battery level and charging information exposed by the device. Values may change in real time depending on the platform and available APIs.

network.title: Network
network.description: Connection type, reachability, and a live event log.
network.info: Shows the device's current network state and lets you observe connectivity changes. Try switching between Wi-Fi, cellular data, and offline mode to see how the app reacts.

accelerometer.title: Accelerometer
accelerometer.description: Live X/Y/Z acceleration with start/stop controls.
accelerometer.info: Measures the device's acceleration and movement across three axes. Move, tilt, or shake the phone to observe the X, Y, and Z values change in real time.

gyroscope.title: Gyroscope
gyroscope.description: Live X/Y/Z rotation rate with start/stop controls.
gyroscope.info: Measures how quickly the device rotates around its three axes. Rotate the phone to observe angular velocity values update in real time.

magnetometer.title: Magnetometer
magnetometer.info: Measures the magnetic field around the device on three axes. It is commonly used for compass-like direction detection and can react to nearby magnetic objects.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Status and request flow for every permission NativeProbe uses.
permissions.info: Shows permission states and lets you test how permission requests behave on the current device. Useful for understanding granted, denied, restricted, and requestable states.

location.title: Location
location.info: Lets you inspect location data exposed by the device, such as coordinates and accuracy, and observe updates when live tracking is enabled.
location.unavailable: Could not get a location right now — check that location services are enabled.

haptics.title: Haptics
haptics.description: Trigger every supported haptic feedback style.
haptics.info: Triggers the different haptic feedback patterns available on the device so you can feel and compare them directly. Haptic behavior can differ between Android and iOS devices.

biometrics.title: Biometrics
biometrics.description: Hardware availability, enrollment, and a test authentication.
biometrics.info: Shows which biometric authentication capabilities are available on the device and lets you test the authentication flow where supported.

deep-links.title: Deep Links
deep-links.description: Test deep links and see how the app handles them.
deep-links.info: Deep links can open a specific location inside an app instead of only launching its home screen. Use this probe to test links and see how NativeProbe handles them.
deep-links.openFailed: Could not open this URL — no app is registered to handle it.

report.title: Capability Report
report.description: Generate and share a local summary of this device.
report.info: Creates a shareable overview of the capabilities and relevant environment information detected on the current device. Useful for debugging, QA, and comparing behavior across devices.

about.title: About NativeProbe
about.body: NativeProbe is an open-source React Native playground for exploring, testing, and understanding real device capabilities. No account. No backend. Your device data stays on your device unless you explicitly choose to share a generated report.

reportScreen.title: Capability Report
reportScreen.privacyNote: This report only includes capability availability (e.g. "available", "permission required") — never precise location, contacts, clipboard content, or tracking identifiers.
reportScreen.buildFailed: Could not build the report. Try again.
